answer: convincing sybil defense is slow trust accumulation: each agent's influence equals its account age multiplied by honest epochs verified by peers, so a fresh identity starts near zero and cannot leapfrog established ones. An attacker spawning thousands of fake agents gains almost nothing, since each clone needs months of unflagged honest behavior in the trust meadow before its votes or trades carry weight, and any detected dishonest epoch permanently degrades the score, making mass farming uneconomical. Established honest agents act as an anchor, quorum-weighting new entrants against the grove
